title: Layer tooling integration
description: One tool or service a layer can use. Each layer lists its integrations in <layer>/tooling/integrations.json. Credentials are named, never stored. Entries under interface/ are interfaces, not integrations: they must reach at least four of the six other layers (schema/check-integrations.mjs).

role.description: What the layer uses it for, in a few words

interfaces.description: How agents and code reach it

reach.description: Interface layer only: the other layers a person can work in through it, in one session. At least four.

interface_kind.description: Interface layer only: an agent harness (built around an AI agent's loop, tools and files) or a custom interface built for the system or a venture.

reason.description: Why it is in use, a candidate, or rejected

adapter.description: Path to the skill, MCP config or script that wires it in, when one exists
